target: temporary workers.dev Worker and temporary Cloudflare R2 bucket

methodology.execution: Disposable Azure Node 22 callers compared the production index-page reuse path with a control wrapper that duplicates each index get.
methodology.matrix: 128, 5,000, and 25,000 documents with one and two secondary indexes.
methodology.primaryLatency: clientElapsedMs measured one complete Trie document update.
methodology.equivalence: Post-run stored documents and active HEAD values were compared between control and candidate prefixes.

limitations: The control reproduces the old operation count by duplicating each immutable index get around the candidate engine.
Azure regions approximate geography and do not represent residential last-mile networks.
One Cloudflare account and one R2 bucket placement were used.
Authentication and browser rendering were excluded.
Cloudflare Worker timers do not measure CPU-only work normally.
